maint.job: Synthetic blend/synthetic oil and filter change
maint.every: Every 5,000-10,000 miles or per the oil-life monitor
maint.note: The EcoBoost engine is harder on oil; shorter intervals help the turbos and timing chain.
The MKT is a heavy three-row vehicle, so brakes wear faster than on a sedan.

maint.every: About every 100,000 miles (often about 60,000 on the EcoBoost)
maint.note: The rear plugs need the upper intake removed. KBB figures shown are for the MKS, which uses the same engines.

maint.every: First at about 100,000 miles or 6 years, then every 50,000
maint.note: Watch the level closely; unexplained coolant loss can mean the internal water pump is leaking.
